label: ercot96 dam hourly grain
definition: ERCOT-96 candidate: ercot91 keeper recipe + ercot_thermal_dam_availability_hourly (class-HOUR DAM availability grain, rule-13 measured re-derive at finer grain, zero fitted parameters), full 2023-2025 span in one bundle (rule 16). 2023 byte-reused from the ercot96_hourly2023_probe A/B (same recipe).
market_story: CC_REGULAR: real combined-cycle capability ambient-derates through summer afternoons — the 60-Day DAM live HSL dips ~0.7% below its own day mean exactly in hod 13-19 — so the market clears those hours on measurably less CC than a day-flat availability credits; the class-HOUR grain removes that phantom (−22 GWh, −64 MW mean on the 181 actual tail hours) and the afternoon supply curve climbs into the $60-100+ belt reality priced. CT_PEAKER: the same ambient physics on the peaker fleet (−18 MW mean tail); overnight both classes gain back the real above-day-mean capability the flat block withheld, which the market never prices (non-binding — trough unchanged, the C7 guard). ST_GAS: with honest CC/CT afternoon capability the steam fleet backfills +24 GWh at its drag-floored positions — the same committed-steam conduct the ercot91 seasonal drag already carries. Zero fitted parameters: the only change is the measured grain of an already-deployed published input.
